reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended The revoked-indicators tile count change has no active review issues. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes #90 in the OpenCTI Splunk add-on’s Monitoring Dashboard so the “Revoked indicators” tile shows a record count instead of the revoked flag. **Changes:** - Filters for `revoked=1` or `revoked=true`, then returns a single count. - Adds a regression test that checks the dashboard’s exact query. It validates the definition, not execution in Splunk. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `tests/​test_dashboard_revoked_tile.py` | Adds a query assertion for the revoked-indicators tile. | | `TA-opencti-for-splunk-enterprise/​custom_dashboard.json` | Replaces grouping by the revoked flag with a filtered count. |
Review effort: Balanced
